senses.gloss: (cmp. זוד) to provide, outfit; to sustain, esp. to feed.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 1:6">Gitt. I, 6</cite> <he>שלא לָזוּן את וכ׳</he> not to sustain his slave.
<cite ref="Gittin 12a:4">Ib. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>איני זָנְךָ</he> I will not support thee.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:2:3">Y. Keth. V, 29ᵈ</cite> top <he>שתהא זוֹנְתוֹ ומפרנסתי</he> (for <he>זָנְתוֹ</he>) that she should provide for all his wants.
<cite ref="Shabbat 104a">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>ז״ח ז̇ן</he> … <he>וח̇ן וכ׳</he> He supports and graces thee; a. fr.—

Ber. 35ᵇ, a. e. כל הזן עלי I vow abstinence from whatever sustains the body.—Trnsf. to feed the eye, to derive pleasure from a sight (mostly of an illicit sight). Ohol. XIII, 4 one makes an opening in the wall לזון את עיניו for the sake of enjoying a view; Tosef. ib. XIV, 4.
<cite ref="Pesachim 26a:4">Pes. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי שלא יָזוּנוּ עיניהם וכ׳</he> that the laborers might not look at the Holy of Holies.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20:10">Lev. R. s. 20</cite> <he>לא זן עיניו מן וכ׳</he> did not look at the Divine Majesty.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23">Lev. R. s. 23</cite>, end <he>ואינו זן וכ׳</he> and does not allow his eye to rest on an obscenity; a. fr.
<cite ref="Gittin 12b:8">Gitt. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ מן הצדקה</he> must be supported from the public charity.
<cite ref="Gittin 12b">Ib.</cite> (distinction betw. <cite ref="N00002"><he>נ׳</he></cite> a. <cite ref="Q01896"><he>התפרנס</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01897"><he>פַּרְנֵס</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 11:1">Keth. XI, 1</cite> <he>נִיזּוֹנֶת מנכסי וכ׳</he> must be supported from the estate &c.

senses.gloss: to outfit, decorate; to gird, arm (cmp. זָוָוא I, a. P. Sm. 1102 sq.) Lev. R. s. 34 (ref. to יחליץ, Is. LVIII, 11) ישמוט יְזַיֵּין וכ׳ it has the meanings of ‘he will loosen’, ‘he will arm’, ‘he will rescue’, ‘he will give rest’.—Part. pass. מְזוּיָּן, מְזוּיָּין.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 57a:14">B. Kam. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>לסטים מ׳</he> a robber in arms; <he>טוען טענת ל׳ מ׳</he> he pleads that he has been robbed by &c. Ib. 58ᵃ; a. e.—Pl. <he>מְזוּיָּנִין</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20">Ex. R. s. 20</cite> (expl. <he>חמשים</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 23:8">Ex. XXIII, 8</cite>) <he>שעלו מ׳</he> they went out fully equipped; Mekh. B’shall., beg.; a. e.

senses.gloss: to arm one’s self, to fight. Tanḥ. Ki Thabo 3 מִזְדַּיֵּין על וכ׳ He goes to war in defense of him &c.
